standard_prerequisites.name: The quantification of the distortion of balls by proximal elements
standard_prerequisites.reference: The quantification of the distortion of balls by proximal elements, the covering of the limit set by images of a fixed ball, and the relation between the critical exponent and the Lipschitz contraction rate of the proximal elements.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies background that the delivered proof uses. The entry is declared as a dependency; it is not re-proved on the card, and the load-bearing steps of the counted statement are carried out inside the delivered span.

core_obligations: Prove that the Hausdorff dimension of the limit set of a projective Anosov subgroup of SL(n,R) is at most its simple weight critical exponent.
proof_roadmap: Step 1: use the quantified distortion lemma to control how a fixed ball is mapped by a proximal element. Step 2: cover the limit set by the images of that ball under the elements whose contraction rate is below a threshold. Step 3: sum the radii of the covering family and let the threshold grow, which bounds the Hausdorff dimension of the limit set by the critical exponent.
